notes.title: Patch 1.03 Details
notes.notes:
Mighty Switch Force! Hyper Drive Edition is back with a brand new update adding additional language support!

[h1]Patch 1.03 - New Features[/h1]

[list][*]Language Support - We've added French, Italian, German, Spanish, and Japanese. New languages can be set by accessing the title's "Properties" menu in the Steam Library and navigating to the "Language" tab.
[/list]

- WayForward

notes.title: Patch 1.02 Details
notes.notes:
This new update includes the following: 

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed issue where Avast antivirus detects the game as malware and deletes it.
    [*]Fixed Korean text being displayed incorrectly on the Leaderboards.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.01 Details
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Mighty Switch Force! Hyper Drive Edition. This new update includes the following: 

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed issue with improper leaderboard messaging.
    [*]Minor fixes to particle effect behavior and game credits.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]Temporarily took out the use of Japanese text (working on a fix currently).
[/list]
